jobs.occupation: Medical Head, Oncology – Denmark – Nordic Marketing Company
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead a country Medical Affairs organization to shape clinical practice and improve outcomes for people living with cancer? In this role, you will set the medical strategy, drive evidence generation, and elevate scientific engagement to close evidence gaps and support access for a portfolio that spans pre-launch through life-cycle management.

Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

You will guide a high-performing office- and field-based team, champion responsible AI adoption, and influence decisions across the enterprise while maintaining Medical independence. How will you translate insights from clinicians, payers and patients into an integrated medical plan that changes practice and accelerates impact?

Accountabilities:

• 
Lead Medical Strategy: Own the country Integrated Medical Plan, connecting therapeutic priorities, patient needs and evidence gaps to measurable impact.

• 
Drive Evidence Generation: Shape the country evidence strategy, including real-world evidence, health data and investigator-sponsored research, in collaboration with Nordic, regional and global teams.

• 
Champion Scientific Leadership: Represent AstraZeneca in scientific and healthcare forums, strengthening our external medical leadership.

• 
Take a proactive and visible leadership internally and externally on how to drive scientific expert mobilisation and advocacy solving market access challenges

• 
Lead by example in external KEE and CoE engagement and establish trusted high level networks of experts

• 
Enable Responsible AI Adoption: Build confidence and capability in AI to enhance scientific impact, efficiency and value, with appropriate human oversight.

• 
Ensure Medical Governance: Provide senior oversight of benefit–risk, compliance and reputational matters, ensuring adherence to internal standards and external regulations.

• 
Influence Cross-Functional Strategy: Bring medical expertise to Market Access, HTA and business planning while safeguarding Medical independence.

• 
Advance Organizational Excellence: Strengthen performance, operating models and ways of working to increase external impact and reduce internal complexity.

• 
Develop Future-Ready Talent: Build a strong leadership pipeline through workforce planning, succession, coaching and inclusive development.

• 
Connect Nordic and Global Priorities: Contribute to Nordic strategy, share best practices across countries and ensure local needs shape broader decision-making.

• 
Manage Resources Strategically: Own medical budgets and deploy resources to priority activities, launches and patient-impact opportunities.

• 
Build Strategic Partnerships: Develop trusted relationships with clinical experts, patient organizations, payers, HTA bodies and healthcare leaders to advance patient outcomes.

Essential Skills/Experience

• 
Scientific Qualification: Advanced degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry, Natural Sciences or a related field.

• 
Medical Affairs Leadership: Significant experience leading Medical Affairs strategy, operations and capabilities across therapeutic areas and product lifecycles.

• 
Launch and Portfolio Expertise: Proven success delivering pre-launch, launch and lifecycle activities for complex portfolios.

• 
Senior Leadership: Experience influencing across cross-functional, matrixed, regional and global environments.

• 
People Leadership: Track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, empowerment and accountability.

• 
Strategic and Business Acumen: Ability to connect medical strategy with brand, value and access priorities while maintaining scientific integrity.

• 
Evidence and Compliance Expertise: Strong understanding of evidence generation, data, responsible AI, regulatory requirements and HTA expectations.

• 
Communication and Influence: Exceptional communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills; fluent in English and the local language.

• 
Agility and Execution: Strategic, analytical and adaptable, with the ability to prioritize, manage complexity and deliver results at pace.

• 
Industry Knowledge and Integrity: Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, healthcare systems and payer environments, with high ethical standards.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• 
Global or Cross-Cultural Experience: Experience working in global organizations or leading international teams.

• 
Additional Qualification: Physician training, PhD or MBA.

• 
Organizational Leadership: Experience leading leaders and developing high-performing organizations.

• 
R&D Collaboration: Experience partnering with Clinical Research, Medical Development or R&D Strategy.

• 
Project Leadership: Strong experience delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

I&D

We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration! Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

Why AstraZeneca

Here, science and strategy meet to change clinical practice. You will work shoulder to shoulder with unexpected teams in the same room unleashing bold thinking—from data scientists and regulatory experts to field-based medical leaders—to create evidence that directly informs how cancer is treated. We unite around a clear purpose, valuing kindness alongside ambition, and empower leaders to experiment, learn and move at pace. Your decisions will ripple from clinics to national systems, backed by real-world data capabilities, cutting-edge analytics and a culture that shares knowledge across roles and levels to turn a strong pipeline into meaningful outcomes for patients.

So, what is next

If you are ready to lead a country medical organization to generate practice-changing evidence, harness responsible AI and shape cancer care at scale, step forward and make your impact now!

jobs.occupation: Student assistants for Digital Archives and Methods, spring 2027
jobs.description:
Introduction to Digital Archives and Methods is a moderately computationally intensive standalone course in History BA.

This course is scheduled on Tuesdays 8 -12 and Thursdays 10 - 14 in weeks 6 - 20. The bulk of assistance is needed in Weeks 6 - 15 in a minimum of 4 hr intervals. Each class is attended by circa 50-60 students who work in groups to complete digital tasks. The course is in-person.

We are looking for 2 teaching student assistants who can support the learners in this course through troubleshooting, assistance and conceptual guidance on the main tasks and themes of the course.

The tasks of the assistants are to provide in-class/remote assistance (in class-time):

· setup:

• assist with local software installations or online instantiations of Voyant, Transkribus, UCloud, R, OpenRefine, etc.

• access to course sources and computational environments

· operation:

• help students operate the tools introduced in the course and

• guide students in the pursuit of course tasks. Help interpret tool outputs during the conceptual work towards assessments.

• Act as student liaisons, translating student needs into technical questions for the instructors.

Selected candidates should show initiative, be digitally savvy and enthusiastic as well as reliable and well-organized. The work requires independence, flexibility, and attention to detail. Furthermore, the candidate should have good interpersonal skills.

The ideal candidate's application should demonstrate the following qualifications:

• Good command of English and Danish, both oral and written

• Familiarity with the course materials as well as the digital tools introduced: previous attendance of Digital Archives and Methods or equivalent is recommended.

• Experience with troubleshooting code and a knack for digital problem-solving

• Proactive, motivated and enthusiastic attitude

• Ability to communicate effectively with students and fellow assistants, as well as liaise with instructors.

Please contact Kathrine Juul Svejstrup kjs@cas.au.dk for more information about the positions.

Applications should address how the applicant fits the qualifications listed above, be written in English and accompanied by a brief CV. Please indicate your availability in class time in weeks 6 to 15 and state which operating systems you are comfortable troubleshooting.

A prerequisite for employment is that the applicant is an actively enrolled student. Employment is subject to the availability of the necessary funding.

Applicants will be notified of the outcome of their application within four weeks of the application deadline.

Terms of Employment

Employment is in accordance with the Ministry of Finance and SUL Finansministeriet og SUL (student instructors).

The application must include a copy of your diploma and any documentation of previous teaching experience.

Aarhus University aims to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for everyone and strives for a culture where each individual can thrive and develop. We view equality and diversity as valuable resources and therefore encourage all interested candidates to apply.

About Arts

The Faculty of Arts is one of Northern Europe’s most significant faculties for research and higher education in the humanities, theology and education. Within this broad academic scope, the faculty comprises approximately 700 researchers, 200 PhD students, 9,000 Bachelor’s and Master’s degree students, and 1,500 further and continuing education students. We believe that the best ideas arise when different perspectives meet – and that research, teaching and innovation are best developed in dialogue with the surrounding society.

You can find more information here: Faculty of Arts | Aarhus Universitet

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Energy as a Senior Power System Engineering Specialist and lead the conceptual and system design of high-voltage substations from 72.5 kV to 420 kV for onshore and offshore projects. The role combines system design decisions in the early tender and conceptual design phase, where you take part in customer dialogues to optimize the system design, with managing the power system studies as a work package in projects. Working closely with customers, project managers and engineering experts, you define the main electrical parameters of the system. Your work turns complex technical requirements into reliable power system solutions that support the future of sustainable energy.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Leading system design activities for high-voltage substations, including AIS and GIS solutions for onshore and offshore applications

• Developing and reviewing single-line diagrams, electrical philosophies, interface definitions and technical concepts, and defining the main electrical parameters for transformers, reactors, switchgear and auxiliary systems

• Managing the power system studies as a work package in projects, planning which studies are needed at each stage so components can be procured with the right data

• Evaluating power system performance and ensuring compliance with grid codes, client specifications and international standards such as IEC and EN

• Providing technical leadership during tendering, project execution, design reviews and risk assessments, including quick calculations to verify proposed concepts

• Collaborating with customers, certification bodies, technology suppliers and engineering teams, and driving technical decision-making and the continuous development of engineering best practices and standards

What You Bring

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related discipline

• Minimum 10 years of experience within high-voltage substation and power system engineering, including transmission substations in the 72.5 kV to 420 kV range

• Proven experience with system design, grid code compliance and power system studies for the grid connection of wind farms, for example from offshore wind, utility-scale transmission or renewable energy integration

• Strong understanding of power system behavior under normal and fault conditions, and practical experience with power transformers, shunt reactors, earthing auxiliary transformers and high-voltage switchgear technologies

• Knowledge of protection and control concepts and power system studies, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

About the Team

This position is part of our Substation engineering department in Denmark, which consists of four engineering teams and a number of specialists reporting directly to the Head of Engineering. The role works across different projects and tenders, together with power system calculation experts in Germany and Denmark.

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.employer_name: Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping
jobs.description:
The opportunity

How could AI help a policy analyst assess a regulatory proposal for global shipping, a researcher make sense of a pile of reports, or a communications colleague turn an idea into a first draft? We’re looking for a curious student who enjoys figuring things out with people and wants to help colleagues use AI in their everyday work.

We’re setting up a new AI team to strengthen how the Center uses AI, and you’ll be one of its first members. You’ll help build the team’s work from the start.

Who we are

We’re the Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping, an independent, not-for-profit research and development center working to decarbonize global shipping. Our team unites experts from many fields – engineers, economists, analysts, software developers and more – who share a passion for making a real difference. We’re based in Copenhagen but collaborate globally.

Who you are

You’re enrolled in a higher education program. We’re open to different subjects and care less about your specific education than about your abilities. What we need is:

• An analytical, problem-solving mindset. You break unfamiliar problems down, ask good questions and work out what someone needs before jumping to a solution.

• Hands-on interest in AI. You already use AI in your studies, work or personal projects and enjoy finding new ways to use it.

• Good with people. You listen and explain things clearly in English, both in conversation and in writing.

• Drive to learn and follow through. You pick things up quickly, act on feedback and finish what you start.

You don’t need coding skills, maritime knowledge or previous professional AI experience.

What you’ll do

You’ll join our new AI team and work closely with the people building it. Specifically, you will:

• Find where AI helps: Talk with colleagues to understand their tasks and where AI might help.

• Test on real tasks: Try out tools and approaches on real work, checking whether the results are useful and reliable.

• Help colleagues get started: Support them through one-to-one conversations, drop-in sessions and short guides that you build and keep up to date.

• See work through: Take smaller tasks and projects through to completion and bring recurring problems back to the team.

You’ll learn alongside us and gradually take on more responsibility as your skills grow.

Why join us

You’ll be part of a new team from the start and help shape how it works. You’ll learn from experienced colleagues while helping them solve real problems. You’ll see how different teams work and build your own skills in AI and problem solving.

Practical details

Based in Copenhagen. 15 to 20 hours per week, with flexibility around studies and exams.

Apply

Send your CV and a short note explaining why this role interests you and what you would bring to it. We’re interested in how you approach unfamiliar problems, work with people and use AI. Examples from studies, personal projects or work are all welcome.

We interview candidates on a continuous basis and may close the recruitment process once the right candidate is found, so please apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Head of Medical Affairs International Markets
jobs.description:
Are you knowledgeable within allergy treatment? Do you like working in an international setting facing different cultures? Bring your expertise in allergy, immunology and medical strategy to a global role where your scientific leadership can make a meaningful difference.

The position

The Head of Medical Affairs International Markets will serve as a therapeutic and disease area expert who is responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy development and structured, consistent and strategically aligned medical engagement across International Markets. International Markets in ALK covers all territories outside Europe and North America. The primary focus is Asia, Middle East and Latin America. The International Markets team is small and diverse with people sitting all over the world and currently covering 12 different native languages. You will be reporting directly to SVP International Markets, Morten Essendrop.

Your Primary Tasks Will Be

Medical Strategy Development

• Responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy and plan for International Markets, leveraging learnings and best practices from Region Europe and Region US Medical Affairs.

• Ensure consistency between strategies, communication and messaging within ALK and across partners allowing for local adaption.

• Support partners with medical expertise and education on ALK products.

• Accountable for publication planning (including congress abstracts, poster presentations, manuscripts) working in close collaboration with local teams and Global Medical Affairs.

External Medical Representation

• Define stakeholder engagement strategies and develop professional relationships with thought leaders to ensure education and scientific communication on ALK products and therapeutic areas of interest. Lead scientific and external engagement strategy for International Markets.

• Represent ALK as medical expert and speaker at selected international congresses, advisory boards, partner meetings and scientific events within International Markets.

• Act as a senior medical ambassador for ALK in key International Markets.

Your profile

We expect that you are a medical doctor with the following qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of the immunology field, strong presentation skills and scientific expertise. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with allergy treatment including allergen specific immunotherapy.

• Knowledge of Medical Affairs standards and processes.

• Ability to develop Medical Affairs strategies and tactical plans.

• Build and interact with a network of allergy/immunology experts, partners and represent ALK in scientific and medical matters. Capable of conducting doctoral level discussions with key customers.

• Ability to collaborate with Global Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations functions locally and globally. Working in a matrix environment.

Become a part of ALK

We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specialised in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation. The result of your efforts will be significant throughout the organisation, and you will be able to actively influence and challenge the status quo.

The position is international with up to 50-60 days of travelling per year. For the ideal candidate flexibility in the workplace can be arranged.

Apply

Apply by attaching your CV and a short letter of motivation.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants. Hence, we prefer that you do not add images to your application documents. We evaluate applications and call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply! We reserve the right to take down the advert when we have found the right candidate.

Do you want to learn more about our company, we encourage you to visit us at www.alk.net.

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

Fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK

At ALK, we believe that every candidate deserves to be evaluated fairly and respectfully. Our recruitment process is designed to give each applicant an equal opportunity, regardless of their background. Read more about fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK.

Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills and experience, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics. jobs.occupation: Finance Manager, Strategic Finance, Synergies Enabler - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong financial toolbox, a strategic mindset and a passion for turning complex business challenges into tangible value? Would you like to play a key role in realizing the value from Arla’s merger with German dairy company DMK?

“As Finance Manager, Synergies Enabler you will become part of the team supporting synergy delivery from the merger with DMK. You will work closely with finance leaders and business stakeholders, acting as a synergy partner and helping connect strategic ambition with financial execution. You will combine hands-on financial analysis with stakeholder management and project execution,” says Theis Engedal Pedersen, Strategic Finance Director.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**Reporting to the Director of Strategic Finance, you will join a highly engaged team of eight finance professionals working close to Arla’s performance management agenda and across our global organization. Your key responsibilities will include

• Partner with finance leads and business stakeholders in solving synergy-related challenges, using financial analysis and modelling to translate business initiatives into measurable financial impact

• Support the identification and quantification of merger synergies, working closely with finance and business stakeholders to establish robust financial baselines, assumptions and value potential

• Support the tracking of synergy realization and P&L impact, creating transparency on progress and helping connect operational delivery with financial outcomes

• Drive efficient and transparent synergy reporting and help turn complex financial information into clear insights and messages for senior management

• Support the broader synergy agenda through strong project management, bringing structure, follow-up and momentum to initiatives involving stakeholders across the organization

**What will make you successful?

**We are looking for someone who combines strong financial capabilities with curiosity, business understanding and an ability to see the bigger picture. You enjoy getting into the details when necessary, but equally important, you can step back, connect the dots and turn complex information into a clear narrative. The ideal candidate brings

• 6+ years of relevant experience from finance or strategy functions; for example finance business partnering, strategic finance, consulting or corporate strategy

• A relevant university degree within Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills, with an ability to translate analysis into insights, recommendations and actions

• A strategic mind and ability to build the bigger picture and develop a compelling narrative from complex information

• A solid project management tool box and is comfortable bringing structure and momentum to complex, cross-functional initiatives.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to condense details into precise, executive-level messages

• Strong relationship building and sparring partnering, and is comfortable collaborating across functions and organizational levels.

**What do we offer?

**This is an opportunity to work on a complex, high-profile merger agenda, where strong partnering skills make a tangible difference to value creation. You will get exposure to a wide range of senior stakeholders across Finance and the wider Arla business and build a broad network across the organization. You will join a young, highly engaged and collaborative Strategic Finance team with strong opportunities for personal and professional development.

**Would you like to join us?

**If you want to help realise the value of the Arla-DMK merger and shape the future of dairy, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis and will close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information, please contact Theis Engedal Pedersen Director of Strategic Finance, on +45 9131 4630

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome.

As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce.

This is where you make a difference

You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation.

One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business.

From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership.

You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg.

Key responsibilities include:

• Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles

• Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles

• Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models

• Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions

What you bring

You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills:

• Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains

• Experience with cloud data platforms and integration architecture

• SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly around Business Partner data

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences

• Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Data engineering, integration or enterprise architecture

• Master data management, metadata, lineage and data quality disciplines

• Event-driven, API-based and batch integration patterns

• CargoWise, logistics or transport-related operations

• Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or similar technologies

• Advanced analytics, AI or relevant certifications such as TOGAF or DAMA

Why Blue Water

You will become part of a well-established Data Management team with strong professional capabilities across governance, master data, migration and quality.

What characterises the team is not only its expertise, but also its willingness to help each other succeed. We work closely together, challenge each other’s thinking and believe that the best solutions are created through collaboration across business and IT.

As part of the wider Operational Excellence organisation, you will work alongside colleagues specialising in process improvement, training and change management. Together, we are helping Blue Water build the capabilities needed for the future.

Interested?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data at Blue Water. If you are ready to make a real impact in a global organisation undergoing significant transformation, we would love to hear from you.

For questions about the role, please contact Kamil J. Karolak, Head of Data Management.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What we do – Together we create solutions

Blue Water Shipping is a global provider of all logistics services in modern supply chain management. Founded in Denmark in 1972, Blue Water is a global organisation of professionals, skilled in offering complete and tailor-made solutions to any shipping requirement anywhere in the world. We offer clients the best service and highest quality in the industry.

The company is represented by more than 80 offices in 30 countries worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise. Every day, our 2,800 employees present a broad range of services, from standardised solutions delivered with optimal user and customer focus, to tailor-made projects with co-created solutions for unique customer needs.

jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist, Downstream, Late-Stage Process Development
jobs.description:
Join a fast-paced process development team where scientific expertise, collaboration and practical problem-solving help advance projects. As Senior Scientist, you will lead downstream development activities for mammalian cell culture processes, supporting their progression through late-stage development.

You will work closely with clients, laboratory technicians and colleagues across upstream, downstream and analytical disciplines. The role combines scientific leadership, study design, data interpretation and technical writing. Most hands-on laboratory work will be performed by technicians; you will work closely with them to develop protocols, design experiments and guide execution, ensuring studies are scientifically sound and generate decision-quality data.

**A role with scientific ownership and real project impact

**As a Senior Scientist, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of downstream development activities and contribute directly to the progression of projects. You will combine your scientific expertise with practical problem-solving and collaborate with both internal colleagues and clients.

The role gives you exposure to different projects, technologies and challenges rather than focusing on one narrow area. You will be involved in shaping studies, interpreting data and turning scientific findings into clear recommendations that support project decisions.

Your work will also give you the opportunity to collaborate closely with laboratory technicians and scientists, allowing you to stay connected to the practical side of process development while taking a leading role in the scientific direction.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead and coordinate downstream development activities for assigned projects, working with clients and cross-functional teams to align on project needs and deliver outcomes.

• Plan and evaluate downstream processes, including chromatography using ÄKTA systems and filtration operations such as depth filtration, virus filtration and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Design studies and author practical protocols in close collaboration with laboratory technicians; provide scientific guidance during experimental execution.

• Interpret study results, apply appropriate statistical approaches—including design of experiments (DoE) where relevant—and communicate findings through clear presentations and reports.

• Contribute to process characterization, including failure mode and risk assessments such as FMEA, and author process characterization (PC) work reports.

• Support investigations and deviation handling by assessing technical causes, interpreting relevant data, and documenting conclusions and follow-up actions.

• Provide scientific and technical input to business activities and support the generation of information for regulatory submissions.

**Required Qualifications And Experience

**

• Education: Master’s or PhD in Biochemistry, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, or a related discipline.

• Industrial experience: 5+ years with a Master’s degree, or 2+ years with a PhD.

• Downstream development: Demonstrated experience with mammalian cell culture processes.

• Unit operations: Chromatography and filtration; ideally ÄKTA systems and TFF systems.

• Study execution and data: Ability to plan, analyze and report complex development studies, including statistical analysis.

• Project work: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with scientific rigour and attention to detail.

• Communication: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to explain technical findings clearly to clients and colleagues.

• Language: Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience

**

• Process Characterization and FMEA

• Viral clearance studies or activities.

• Commercial manufacturing requirements and biologics regulatory frameworks, including relevant ICH guidelines and BLA submission requirements.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), including experimental design, data analysis, and evaluation using SAS JMP

• Liquid-handling automation, such as Tecan systems.

**What Will Help You Succeed

**You take ownership, bring a practical can-do attitude and are comfortable working at pace. You collaborate closely with technicians and colleagues, communicate openly, and use data and sound scientific judgement to find a way forward as project needs and priorities evolve.

**What You Can Expect From Us

**We want you to have the opportunity to use your scientific expertise while continuing to develop professionally. In this role, you can expect:

• Scientific ownership: Take responsibility for development activities and influence how studies are designed and executed.

• Variety: Work across different projects, technologies and scientific challenges rather than doing the same thing every day.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with scientists, technicians, upstream and analytical colleagues as well as clients.

• Client exposure: Develop your ability to communicate scientific findings and recommendations directly with clients and contribute to project discussions.

• Professional development: Continue developing your expertise in downstream processing, process characterization, data analysis and late-stage development.

• Impact: See how your scientific work contributes to advancing biopharmaceutical processes towards later-stage development and manufacturing.

**A team where science and collaboration go hand in hand

**You will become part of a team where scientific knowledge, practical experience and collaboration are important to how we work. We value people who share knowledge, ask questions and are willing to challenge and support each other.

You will work closely with experienced colleagues across different disciplines, giving you the opportunity to learn from others while also bringing your own expertise to the team.

We believe that good science is strengthened by open communication, different perspectives and a willingness to find solutions together.

**Ready to make your next move?

**If you are looking for a role where you can combine scientific expertise, project ownership, client interaction and practical problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through the AGC Biologics career site by **31 October 2026.

**Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system and cannot accept CVs by email.

**The Recruitment Process Will Include

**

• An initial screening interview with People & Culture

• An interview with the Hiring Manager

• A final interview, including a cognitive assessment and personality assessment

• A meet and greet with team members and a laboratory tour

• Reference checks

Applications will be reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We may close the position before the application deadline once the right candidate has been identified.

_Location: We can only consider candidates currently based in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area, as relocation support is not available for this position.

_At AGC Biologics, we are committed to a fair and unbiased recruitment process. We assess candidates based on their skills, experience, qualifications, and potential to succeed in the role.

To support an objective recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your application or CV.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.occupation: Product Coordinator - Data, structure, and coordination at the heart of our largest product category.
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who enjoys bringing order to complexity? Do you take pride in keeping track of details, data, and deadlines? Then you could be the Coordinator we are looking for in our Incontinence and baby diapers team at ABENA!

Incontinence and baby diapers are ABENA's largest product category. At the same time, we are welcoming new digital and innovative product areas into the team, creating exciting opportunities but also increasing the need for structure and coordination. That's why we are looking for a new colleague who can help keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.

This is a role with a very broad range of responsibilities. One day you might be updating master data, checking marketing materials, working with price lists, or creating Excel reports. The next day you could be following up on backorders, supporting a product launch, or helping solve an unexpected operational challenge. New tasks will constantly land on your desk, so it's important that you enjoy variety and take pride in bringing order to complexity.

Simply put, you are the person who puts things on track and helps keep the train moving.

You can expect your main tasks to include:

• Maintain product information and master data across our systems.

• Support new product launches and help coordinate activities across departments.

• Follow up on backorders and product availability, keeping Sales updated.

• Create reports and work with product, pricing, and sales data in Excel.

• Support process improvements, data clean-up, and documentation of workflows.

• Prepare project updates, newsletters, and other communication for internal stakeholders.

We hope you bring:

• A relevant education within business, administration, supply chain, marketing, or a related field.

• An interest in working with product data, reports, and master data, along with a willingness to learn new systems.

• Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

• The ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and keep track of many moving parts.

• Confidence working in Excel and a curiosity for turning data into useful insights.

• A proactive and helpful mindset, with a genuine desire to support colleagues and contribute wherever needed.

Your Team, Our Culture and Values

Our team brings together five complementary experts in product management, sourcing, and compliance. We’re driven by a genuine passion for our work and a deep commitment to our category and products. We support one another, celebrate our successes together, and ensure we thrive as a team.

Your leader at ABENA will be Group Concept Manager Birgitte Hausted, who describes her leadership style as follows:

“I adapt my leadership style to the people and teams I work with, and I always meet others with respect for their expertise and strengths. I don’t see failure as losing. I see it as learning and getting better together. Trust and transparency matter a lot to me, and I believe we do our best work when we reflect on and grow as a team.”

Your workplace will be located at the ABENA Headquarter in Aabenraa, Denmark.

At ABENA, you join a global company with a strong purpose: To make a real difference in the everyday lives of people around the world. We combine professionalism with a warm, people-first culture where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement are necessary parts of everyday life. We take pride in delivering high-quality work with integrity, guided by our core values of trust, fairness, and cooperation. These values shape how we lead, support one another, and create meaningful impact for our customers and communities.

We look forward to receiving your application

If you are interested in the position, please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We process applications as we receive them, and we close the search when we have found our new colleague.

Read more about our recruitment process here.

If you would like further information about the job, please feel free to contact Birgitte Hausted, Group Concept Manager, on +45 5158 0484.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Danfoss Business System (DBS) was founded in 2003 and is a world class improvement organization with one overall purpose: To ensure that Danfoss has a best-in-class performance. The organization consists of highly qualified specialists split into more than 20 nationalities, who can all challenge and support the businesses as well as develop the practices and solutions needed to take Danfoss to the next level.

DBS specializes in supporting Danfoss factories with a standardized approach to continuously strengthen Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Inventory.

As a Delivery Performance Excellence Expert, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement effective supply chain processes that improve delivery performance to customers and enhance customer satisfaction, with a strong end-to-end focus. The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to transformation initiatives and make a tangible impact on business results.

In this role, you will be operating in a multicultural environment with highly competent colleagues from all over the world.

We are a global organization with more than 100 factories across the world and therefore it is important that you have the flexibility and willingness to travel, approx. 70% of the time supporting our various locations. When not travelling, you will have the flexibility of working from home or from one of our offices.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead supply chain transformation projects across manufacturing sites, identifying and implementing end-to-end improvements in planning, procurement, production, logistics, and customer service.

• Drive delivery performance excellence using DBS methodologies, helping factories improve customer delivery results and achieve ambitious performance targets.

• Implement and strengthen performance management systems, using data and insights to monitor results, identify gaps, and accelerate improvements.

• Drive continuous improvement across Delivery and Inventory through facilitation of Kaizen workshops, process mapping activities, and capability-building initiatives, enabling teams to adopt sustainable ways of working.

• Partner with stakeholders across operations, supply chain, and support functions to build a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and high performance.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Proven experience in supply chain management within a manufacturing environment, with expertise in areas such as SIOP, Planning, Procurement, CRM, WMS, or TMS

• Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes and hands-on experience leading supply chain transformation and performance improvement initiatives in manufacturing Industry or consultancy supporting manufacturing industry.

• Experience working with SAP, Planning & Forecasting systems, SAP BI, Power BI, and advanced Excel for analysis and decision-making.

• Strong project leadership, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence teams across a matrix organization. A structured, analytical, and data-driven approach to problem-solving, combined with excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Interest and experience in digital technologies, data analytics, process transformation, and operational excellence.

• Willingness and flexibility to travel globally up to 70% of the time.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. More information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Are you ready to take the commercial lead of a global Service business and drive its next phase of profitable growth?

KK’s Service business generates approximately DKK 800m in annual revenue and is an increasingly important contributor to the company’s growth and profitability. To build on this strong foundation, we are looking for a Senior Director, Global Service Sales to lead our international Service Sales organisation across Denmark, Spain, the USA and China.

In this role, you will have overall responsibility for driving profitable growth across the Service business. You will set the commercial direction, strengthen key customer relationships and further develop our sales capabilities, while ensuring strong execution across pricing, pipeline management and business development.

Reporting to the VP Service, you will be a key member of the Service leadership team and play an important role in shaping the future direction and continued growth of the business.

The role

We are looking for a commercially driven leader who combines strategic thinking with strong execution and people leadership.

You know how to set a clear direction and turn commercial ambitions into results. At the same time, you stay close to customers, markets and your organisation, giving you a strong understanding of where the opportunities are and what it takes to capture them.

As a leader, you create clarity, accountability and momentum. You build strong teams, empower people to take ownership and bring the organisation with you as the business continues to grow.

Key responsibilities:

As Senior Director, Global Service Sales, you will have overall responsibility for driving the commercial development and performance of our global Service business. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Service business, driving sustainable and profitable growth across markets

• Identify and develop new business opportunities while strengthening KK’s aftermarket and Service offering

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and strategic stakeholders

• Strengthen pricing discipline, commercial decision-making and account management across regions

• Build a strong sales pipeline and improve forecasting, commercial planning and performance follow-up

• Translate market developments, customer needs and competitive insights into concrete commercial opportunities

• Lead, develop and motivate an international sales organisation across Denmark, Spain, the USA and China

• Build a strong performance culture with clear accountability, customer focus and commercial excellence

• Develop commercial capabilities and future leaders while ensuring the organisation is equipped for continued growth

• Work closely with Service Operations, Engineering, Project Management and other functions to ensure strong commercial execution

• Drive collaboration and knowledge sharing across regions and act as a visible and trusted member of the Service leadership team

Your profile

We are looking for a commercially driven leader with a strong track record of delivering growth through people, customer relationships and business development.

You will likely bring:

• Significant experience in senior commercial or sales leadership roles, ideally from Service, Aftermarket or other similar recurring revenue businesses. Experience within the wind industry is advantageous.

• Responsibility for delivering profitable growth in an international business

• Experience leading teams across multiple countries and cultures

• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking

• A proven ability to build customer relationships at senior levels

• Experience operating successfully in a matrix organisation

• A structured and data-driven approach to sales management

Location

Ikast, Denmark

How to Apply

If you can see yourself in the role and match the above qualifications, we look forward to receiving your application. Please note that due to vacation in week 42, we will start review candidates in week 43.

For questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact:

Anne Høj

anhoj@kkgroup.com

About KK Group

Building on more than 40 years of experience, KK Group is a leading systems supplier to the renewable energy industry. Our capabilities span the development of state-of-the-art technologies, high-quality lean manufacturing, and flexible aftermarket services.

KK Group is owned by A.P. Moller Holding, the parent company of the A.P. Moller Group, established in 1904 by Arnold Peter Møller. We are a global and diverse organization of more than 3,700 employees, working to deliver products and services that enable a future powered by renewable energy.

At KK Group, our culture and DNA are built on a foundation of a can-do attitude and innovation. We actively foster an inclusive work environment that embraces diversity, rejects any form of discrimination, and ensures equal opportunities for all. Our commitment is to cultivate a strong culture centered on health, safety, wellbeing, and effective teamwork.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Campaign Design - Store Creative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

What you will do

Drive retail campaign experiences

• 
Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• 
Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• 
Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• 
Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable globally while remaining flexible for local markets.

Lead global campaign toolkits

• 
Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• 
Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• 
Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

Lead and develop creative talent

• 
Inspire, coach and develop a multidisciplinary creative team.

• 
Guide concept development and provide constructive creative feedback.

• 
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation and high creative standards.

Partner across the business

• 
Collaborate with Communications, Operations, Product Design and other key functions to deliver cohesive campaign experiences.

• 
Present concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• 
Work with external agencies, artists and production partners to bring ideas to life.

Deliver from concept to execution

• 
Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

• 
Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and operational realities.

• 
Manage multiple campaign workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Who you are

You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

We imagine you bring

• 
Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• 
Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• 
A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• 
Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• 
Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• 
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• 
Professional fluency in English.

What will make you stand out

A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Operations team, working primarily with Azure, AWS and partially in GCP. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that all engineers think about automation and streamlining first.

Your Role & Impact

We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We want to build a modern, strong and scalable platform for our many subsidiaries(120+ companies) and we need the right people to do that.

You will be doing hands-on work on our many platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities

• Operate and optimize Egmont’s multi-cloud environments

• Automate routine and repetitive tasks and streamline operations.

• Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring in our tools – We use Datadog

• Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standard and detect drift

• Drive modernization initiatives to reduce manual work and promote automation

• Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

• Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Desired Skills

• Experience from previous cloud engineering, operations or DevOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (GCP is also a plus)

• Scripting skills in any popular language

• Experience with IaC tools, any apply but we use Terraform

• Good understanding of networking

• Experience working with modern observability tools like Datadog

• Knows how to setup, configure and operate server based infrastructure, running both Linux and Windows

• Working with source control in GitHub or similar providers

• Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s rethinking how cloud operations are done.

Why Egmont?

At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

Logistics & How to Apply

• Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1120 Copenhagen K, Denmark

• Application deadline: November 14, 2026

• Interviews: Will be scheduled from week 47.

Please send your application as soon as possible — we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English.

To apply, please use the "Apply" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Sabine Lübcke (Senior IT Manager, Cloud & Network) at sabine.lubcke@egmont.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

Are you passionate about product data and the systems that turn it into consistent, high-quality experiences everywhere it's used? Do you enjoy the technical challenge of connecting complex data flows across platforms? Do you thrive on making product information easy to find, understand, and trust—for customers and for AI? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Pandora's team is looking for a Product Manager to own our Product Information Management (PIM) practice. PIM is central to our architecture, syndicating product data to ecommerce, marketplaces, retail, and marketing systems, so you'll work at the intersection of data architecture, content quality, and discoverability.

As our new Product Manager, you'll own the product strategy and delivery for our PIM platform, with InRiver preferred as our PIM technology. You'll work closely with data, engineering, and content teams to define the data model, govern data quality, and ensure product information flows correctly to every downstream channel.

This role is critical to how our products are found and understood—not just by customers on our own site, but increasingly by AI-driven answer engines and generative search. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands-on technical execution, vendor management, and continuous improvement of our data model.

Help Write Our Next Chapter - Job Responsibilities:

• Own the product roadmap and backlog for our PIM platform, ensuring the data model and architecture support both business and technical needs

• Design and optimize data flows between PIM and downstream systems (ecommerce, marketplaces, DAM, ERP), working closely with engineering

• Partner with content, SEO, and marketing teams to structure and enrich product information for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

• Manage vendor relationships, including roadmap alignment, issue escalation, and feature adoption

• Monitor data quality, syndication performance, and platform health, identifying optimization opportunities and driving continuous improvement

• Stay ahead of trends in PIM, product data architecture, and AI-driven discovery, bringing forward strategic recommendations

We would love if you could bring:

• 5+ years of experience in product management, data platforms, or PIM—ideally within ecommerce or product content operations

• Technical understanding of PIM architecture, data modeling, and system integrations (APIs, ETL, syndication)

• Experience with InRiver or similar PIM platforms preferred

• Experience optimizing product information for AEO and GEO—structured data, schema markup, and content formats that AI systems and search engines can parse

• Experience writing clear product requirements and managing backlogs in tools like JIRA

• Analytical mindset with a focus on measuring data quality and discoverability impact

• Excellent stakeholder management skills—you can navigate between technical and business teams with ease

• Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, consent management) is a plus

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we’d love to hear your story!

Meet the People Behind the Sparkle

You’ll join our Product Management team, alongside colleagues in Copenhagen and Baltimore, working in a collaborative and international environment. Reporting directly to the Director, Product Management, you’ll work closely with teams across e-commerce, stores, retail technology, brand, marketplaces and local markets, giving you broad exposure across Pandora and plenty of opportunity to collaborate across the business.

Further Information:

Global Career Band: This role is a Manager, Band 4B, individual contributor position.

Be Part of Something Beautiful

At Pandora, we’re crafting more than jewellery. We’re creating the future of an iconic global brand. You’ll work from our Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen alongside talented colleagues from around the world, helping shape the digital experiences, platforms, and technologies that support millions of customers and employees every day. From our LEED Gold-certified workplace to our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and craftsmanship, Pandora offers an environment where you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and make a lasting impact.

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology site in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s ambitions. Besides our inspiring workplace design, we’re proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This reflects our commitment to using natural resources responsibly and creating a space that is professional, dynamic, comfortable, and uniquely Pandora. The result is a workplace that is innovative, collaborative and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here or comes to visit.

Join us in this role where you will contribute to the development and implementation of our global workplace strategy and translate business requirements into effective, future-focused workplace solutions. Working closely with internal specialists and external partners, you will bring together the expertise needed to shape solutions aligned with our global Love Your Workplace concept. You will lead workplace projects from early location analysis and space planning through workplace programming, where data, business requirements, work patterns and stakeholder needs are translated into clear workplace requirements and design briefs. The role combines workplace project leadership, strategic space management, data analytics, and stakeholder engagement, with a strong focus on workplace experience and performance.

**Welcome to Global Real Estate & Workplace Management

**You'll be part of Workplace Development, a team within Global Real Estate & Workplace Management (GREWM). Together, we're responsible for developing and evolving Love Your Workplace, our global workplace concept for how offices are designed, used, and experienced across the organization. We collaborate with colleagues across Facilities Management, IT, People & Culture, Procurement, Security, and business leadership to create workplaces that support collaboration, wellbeing, productivity, and sustainability.

As a team, we bring together diverse professional backgrounds and expertise to continuously improve workplace experience for our colleagues around the world. You'll join a collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued and where you'll have opportunities to influence workplace solutions across our global portfolio.

**You'll play an important role in:

**

• Implementing and managing global workplace concepts, standards and policies, while driving the adoption and continued reinforcement of activity-based working

• Translating organizational, functional, and employee requirements into practical workplace solutions and a clear project-specific vision

• Leading workplace projects from pre-project planning and location assessment through programming, design, delivery, implementation, handover, and post-occupancy follow-up

• Advising on space requirements and supporting real estate and lease-selection decisions through test fits and workplace data

• Leading and coordinating the development of project briefs, zoning principles, test fits, layouts, and design plans in collaboration with decision-makers and workplace ambassadors

• Applying and continuously improving occupancy and capacity-planning methodologies

• Identifying opportunities for right-sizing, consolidation, and portfolio optimization, and supporting workplace business cases and project prioritization

• Supporting in collecting and analyzing real estate, people, occupancy and utilization data and converting findings into actionable recommendations

• Using and contributing to the development of workplace KPI and benchmarking frameworks to support evidence-based decisions

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Bring strong workplace project leadership skills, combined with strategic workplace understanding and solid end-to-end project management experience, preferably from workplace, office fit-out or implementation of ABW projects.
